description: This is a header file for the STM32F4 series HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) extension for Flash memory operations. It defines data structures, constants, macros, and function prototypes to manage flash memory erasure, programming, and option bytes configuration on STM32F4 microcontrollers.

classes.name: FLASH_EraseInitTypeDef
classes.description: Structure defining the parameters for flash memory erase operations.

classes.name: FLASH_OBProgramInitTypeDef
classes.description: Structure defining parameters for programming flash option bytes.

classes.name: FLASH_AdvOBProgramInitTypeDef
classes.description: Structure for advanced flash option bytes programming to support extended features.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase
methods.description: Erases specified sectors or entire flash memory.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase_IT
methods.description: Initiates an interrupt-driven flash erase operation.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBProgram
methods.description: Programs the flash option bytes with specified configurations.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBGetConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current flash option bytes configuration.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_AdvOBProgram
methods.description: Programs advanced options bytes for extended features.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_AdvOBGetConfig
methods.description: Gets the current advanced option bytes configuration.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OB_GetBank2WRP
methods.description: Returns the write protection configuration status for Bank 2 sectors.
